decision_rule: Primary attacked BB AP takes priority within the original 23 registered configurations and their own declared schedules; preserve each control setting rather than replacing the complete family with the nominee schedule.

Nominate A10 using full-panel primary ranking, direct alternative comparisons, descriptive target/family composition sensitivity and existing nested-layer evidence; none of these establish global or cross-seed optimality.
Accept the observed YOLO-family and some small/medium-object or recall tradeoffs for this overall-AP objective; disclose them rather than voting across correlated secondary metrics.
A real pre-existing resource or budget violation can block execution. Additional feature terms or an ordinary measured timing difference alone do not invent a new veto threshold.

Final scientific freeze additionally requires adequate final-background evidence for the actual paper claims, exact implementation qualification and accepted cost/input provenance. Contradictory core evidence triggers recorded reconsideration, not automatic fallback or silent method splicing.

controls.name: identity_scale
controls.question: Whether sampled paired scale views improve the fixed final design over identity geometry.
controls.interpretation: Does not isolate correspondence; only scale_min and scale_max change.

controls.name: neck_only_three
controls.question: Whether adding the registered backbone surface improves on the three-level neck-only objective.
controls.interpretation: Changes representation and feature-term count; not equal-physical-cost pure-stage causality.

controls.name: backbone_only_three
controls.question: Whether the joint backbone-neck objective improves on the corresponding three-level backbone-only objective.
controls.interpretation: Retains the original joint-versus-single-surface scientific question; term count also changes.

controls.name: independent_offsets
controls.question: Whether spatially paired crops and padding help when branch scales remain equal.
controls.interpretation: Effective content coverage and valid-support overlap can change.

controls.name: independent_geometry
controls.question: Whether shared complete geometry helps relative to independent clean/adversarial views.
controls.interpretation: Compare with F04 to distinguish scale synchronization from offset pairing; not pure correspondence causality.

controls.name: none_twenty_feature
controls.question: Whether allocating one of twenty gradients to detector initialization improves over twenty feature updates from identity.
controls.interpretation: Budgeted schedule comparison, not identical follow-up length or identical physical computation.

controls.name: random_twenty_feature
controls.question: Whether the detector-guided schedule improves on a registered nonzero random start followed by twenty feature gradients.
controls.interpretation: Random sign amplitude is the existing one-pixel step, using the independent initialization RNG stream.

controls.name: uniform_weight
controls.question: Whether detached clean-feature energy weighting improves on uniform weighting over the same valid support.
controls.interpretation: Feature energy is not an independently established foreground or semantic-importance estimator.

controls.name: mean_aggregation
controls.question: Whether smooth survival aggregation improves over an arithmetic mean of the same six feature terms.
controls.interpretation: A conditional aggregator comparison, not a minimax guarantee or an energy-by-aggregation interaction test.
